appointments: Appointments are scheduled by phone during office hours at (630) 381-4021. The appointment page explains what a first visit involves and what to bring.
reschedule: To change or cancel an appointment, please call the office during business hours at (630) 381-4021.
smart: SMART (Safe Mercury Amalgam Removal Technique) is a protocol of precautions used when an amalgam filling is removed. Whether a filling should be replaced is a clinical decision first: the FDA does not recommend removing intact amalgam fillings unless a clinician considers it necessary.
ozone: Dental ozone is used as an optional adjunct in selected treatments. It does not replace cleaning, fillings or other care a tooth needs, and the evidence for some uses is still developing.
massage: Therapeutic massage details, including availability, are on the service page.
membership: Raina offers two in-house plans: a Standard Adult Plan ($62.50 a month or $750 a year) and a Child Wellness Plan for children 12 and under ($43.33 a month or $520 a year). They cover routine preventive care and are not insurance; current terms are confirmed at enrollment.
approach: Raina’s whole-person approach considers your health history, preferences and the materials used in your mouth, alongside a thorough dental exam and evidence-based treatment.
payment: Coverage depends on your plan. The insurance and payment page explains in- and out-of-network benefits, estimates and payment options. For your specific plan, please call the office.
hours: Office hours are Monday noon to 6 pm; Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 9 am to 5 pm; closed Wednesday. Holiday hours may differ, so please call to confirm.
location: The practice is at 2323 Naperville Road, Suite 110, Naperville, IL 60563.
technology: Photographs, X-rays and digital models are used to show you what the dentist sees and to plan care. Only the images your care needs are taken.
services: The treatment directory lists every service with a plain-language explanation and a search for everyday terms like ‘cleaning’ or ‘implant’.
team: Dr. Mandeep Raina, DDS, leads the practice alongside Dr. Prameela B. To speak with the team, call (630) 381-4021.
first-visit: A first visit starts with a conversation about your history and goals, followed by a thorough exam. Tell the team if you feel anxious; it helps them plan your visit.
reviews: You can read patient reviews on the patient stories page and in full on Google.
